diff_summary: Refactored CRUD resource routing to domain APIRouter using FastAPI Depends(current_user), Depends(admin), Depends(get_race_db), and Depends(get_race_telemetry) with fallback to repository and runtime state. Eliminated 15-lambda forwarding block in main.py, directly mounted crud_router, preserved backwards compatibility for create_crud_router and register_resources, keeping full OpenAPI parity.
